name: Vertical Loop Carousel
description: 3D cascading card stack carousel where images tilt back above and below the active card, with name and role beside it, arrows, dots, and swipe navigation in an endless loop.
contents: Stack of image cards with perspective depth
Name and role heading for the active item
behavior: Cards above and below tilt, scale and fade by distance from the active one
Click a side card or dot to jump to it
Vertical swipe on touch moves to next or previous
Optional autoplay at a set interval
editableByProps: Cards: image, name and role, any count

needsCodeEdit.change: Change card tilt, depth or spacing
needsCodeEdit.where: positionClasses assignments inside the items.map block

fixed: Fills at least the viewport height
Card sizes are fixed per breakpoint
Renders a blank placeholder until mounted
